steps.claim: Ten record-streaming albums come out, from Drake's Scorpion to Taylor Swift's Midnights

test.source: “Smartphones, Online Music Streaming, and Traffic Fatalities,” JAMA Network Open, 2026

steps.note: The study takes the ten albums with the most first-day streams from 2017 to 2022. Dated here to the first of those release days, Scorpion on June 29, 2018.

steps.claim: Big release days saw about 18 more deaths on US roads

test.design: release days against the 10 days before and after
test.source: “Smartphones, Online Music Streaming, and Traffic Fatalities,” JAMA Network Open, 2026
test.effect: 18.2 more US traffic deaths on an average release day, a 15.1% rise, as streaming jumped 43%

steps.note: From the paper: “major music album releases, accompanied by increased online streaming, were associated with a significant increase in traffic fatalities.” The extra deaths were higher among younger male drivers, crashes with one person in the car and cars with built-in infotainment screens.

steps.claim: A European football club with an African player loses a close game

test.source: “Do Politically Irrelevant Events Cause Conflict? The Cross-continental Effects of European Professional Football on Protests in Africa,” International Organization, 2023

steps.note: The study covers 15,102 close games from 2005 to 2019. Dated here to the first year.

steps.claim: More peaceful protests in the player's home country after his club loses a close game

test.design: close losses against draws, adjusted for the betting odds
test.source: “Do Politically Irrelevant Events Cause Conflict? The Cross-continental Effects of European Professional Football on Protests in Africa,” International Organization, 2023
test.effect: more peaceful protests in the player's home country after a close loss, with no change in riots or armed conflict

steps.note: From the paper: “close losses of African players’ teams increase peaceful protests in their original countries while not changing the likelihood of riots or armed conflicts.” An earlier version (IDE Discussion Paper 866, 2022) put the rise at nearly double the usual protest rate. Close wins did not lower protests.

steps.claim: A truck attack on a Stockholm shopping street kills five people

test.source: “The effect of a terrorist attack on emergency department inflow: an observation study using difference-in-differences methodology,” Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine, 2019

steps.note: The attack came on April 7, 2017, the Friday a week before Good Friday.

steps.claim: Fewer people went to Stockholm's emergency rooms for about three weeks

test.design: difference in differences against the same hospitals in 2013 to 2016
test.source: “The effect of a terrorist attack on emergency department inflow: an observation study using difference-in-differences methodology,” Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine, 2019
test.effect: 7% to 9% fewer emergency room visits, strongest near the attack and back to normal in about three weeks

steps.note: From the paper: “The study shows a statistically significant reduction in overall ED inflow of 7-9% following the attack.” The drop faded with distance and was not significant beyond 10 km. ED means an emergency department.

steps.claim: Greece moves its clocks forward an hour each spring

test.source: “Summertime and the drivin’ is easy? Daylight saving time and vehicle accidents,” Health Economics, 2023

steps.note: The study covers every spring and fall clock change from 2006 to 2016. Dated here to the first year.

steps.claim: Fewer serious road crashes in the days after the clocks go forward

test.design: regression discontinuity at the clock change
test.source: “Summertime and the drivin’ is easy? Daylight saving time and vehicle accidents,” Health Economics, 2023
test.effect: 15% to 20% fewer serious crashes after the spring change, strongest in the hours the change affects most

steps.note: From the paper: “The sizable discontinuity parameters suggest that the Spring transition causes a 15%–20% decrease in serious crashes.” Minor crashes rose about 13% after the fall change. Quoted from the published article's open copy at City, University of London.

steps.claim: Britain moves its clocks forward in spring and back in fall

test.source: “Road traffic casualties in Great Britain at daylight savings time transitions: a causal regression discontinuity design analysis,” BMJ Open, 2022

steps.note: The study covers both clock changes in every year from 2005 to 2018. Dated here to the first year.

steps.claim: Slightly fewer road casualties right after the clocks change

test.design: regression discontinuity at the clock changes
test.source: “Road traffic casualties in Great Britain at daylight savings time transitions: a causal regression discontinuity design analysis,” BMJ Open, 2022
test.effect: about 4.7 fewer road casualties and 0.75 fewer deaths a year across both changes, a minor drop

steps.note: From the paper: “All significant average treatment effects are negative (54 significant models out of 287 estimated), indicating that there are fewer casualties following the transitions.” The authors say this does not support a UK parliamentary estimate of 30 fewer deaths a year if the clock changes ended.

steps.claim: Terror attacks in Barcelona and Cambrils kill sixteen people

test.source: “Terrorist attacks, Islamophobia and newborns’ health,” Journal of Health Economics, 2021

steps.note: The first attack came in Barcelona on the afternoon of August 17, 2017.

steps.claim: More low-birth-weight babies born to mothers from Muslim countries in the towns attacked

test.design: triple difference by the mother's origin, her town, and before or after
test.source: “Terrorist attacks, Islamophobia and newborns’ health,” Journal of Health Economics, 2021
test.effect: the share of low-birth-weight babies rose 23.77% and deliveries with complications 13.02% among mothers from Muslim countries in Barcelona, Cambrils and Ripoll

steps.note: From the paper: “Results show that the share of low-birth-weight babies and deliveries with complications raise significantly by 23.77%, and 13.02%.” The study counts only babies conceived before the attacks. It also found more Islamophobia and more emotional distress in the same group.

steps.claim: Undersea fiber cables bring broadband internet to Senegal

test.source: “Impact of Broadband Internet on Preventive Healthcare Behaviors in Senegal,” Economie et Statistique / Economics and Statistics, 2024

steps.note: The cables arrived in 2010. Dated here to that year.

steps.claim: More young children slept under a bednet in homes near the new fiber line

test.design: difference in differences, homes near the fiber line against homes farther away
test.source: “Impact of Broadband Internet on Preventive Healthcare Behaviors in Senegal,” Economie et Statistique / Economics and Statistics, 2024
test.effect: 7.8 to 14.3 percentage points more homes where children under 5 slept under a bednet the night before

steps.note: From the paper: “Broadband access is found to be positively associated with the use of bednet.” The 7.8-point estimate matches mothers on place, wealth, education and more; the 14.3-point one uses fixed effects. Results for prenatal care were mixed, and child vaccination did not change.
